title: destination preset v1
description: docs/25 §2.3: one app as data. cpad ships some (daemon/src/cpad/dest/presets/v1); yours go in $CPA_HOME/presets/*.json (0600) or cpa dest add --preset-file. Unknown fields are refused, so no field can hold a secret. The schema is the shape; cpad also refuses denied schemes, routes and handlers (presets/v1/deny.json), templates of any other shape (README), and credentials in map values.

preset.description: the preset's id; yours may not reuse a shipped one

label.description: at most 24 UTF-8 bytes (cpad counts bytes)

bundle.description: CFBundleIdentifier of the app; it is pinned with its Team ID when the destination is added

leaves_mac.description: the text may leave this Mac (a url destination always does)

key_hint.description: suggested letter, used only when free

note.description: shown before you allow it; apps never write their own wording

template.description: url: <scheme>://<host>/<path>?name=value&...; {text} exactly once as a whole query value; {p} and {project} likewise

focus.description: url: same scheme, no {text}; only brings the target forward (overflow, a draft still there)

effect.description: url: absent = unknown, act until this Mac's test answers 'appeared, not sent' (only for shipped presets); act = never a draft

max_text_utf16.description: url: header + text in UTF-16 code units (default 1000)

max_url.description: url: the encoded link in bytes (default 2048)

overflow.description: url: too long or a draft still there -> clipboard + focus, only while the clip destination is on

pattern.description: url: what a {p} value looks like

from_link.description: url: a regular expression with one group taking the value out of a pasted link

path.description: file: relative to the --root you give (.md or .txt)
